workstreams.name: Product
workstreams.goal: Ship Prime Care v2 — one patient app for appointments, care plans and records — and lift weekly active patients by 30%.

tasks.name: Patient onboarding redesign
tasks.description:
**What:** Rebuilding sign-up and first-visit flows: phone-number login, insurance card scan, and a 3-question health profile instead of the current 14-field form.

**Why:** 41% of new users drop off before booking their first consult. Usability sessions show the long form and unclear consent screens are the main causes.

**Blockers:**
- Legal sign-off on the new consent copy (expected this week)

**Next steps:**
- Finish build of insurance scan (OCR vendor integrated)
- A/B test new flow with 20% of traffic from 26 Oct
- Target: first-booking conversion from 59% to 70%

subtasks.name: Insurance card scan (OCR)
subtasks.description: OCR vendor integrated and live in the build.

tasks.name: Care-plan tracker (MVP)
tasks.description:
**What:** A daily view of each patient's care plan — medications, vitals to log, follow-up appointments — with reminders.

**Why:** Chronic-care patients (diabetes, hypertension) are our highest-value cohort; doctors asked for a way to see adherence between visits.

**Blockers:**
- Needs the FHIR gateway (Tech Integrations) to read prescriptions

**Next steps:**
- Finalise designs with 5 partner doctors
- Build medication reminder service
- Beta with 200 patients in December

tasks.name: Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 AA)
tasks.description:
**What:** External audit of the patient app and web portal against WCAG 2.2 AA, followed by fixes.

**Why:** Many of our patients are older adults; enterprise customers also require an accessibility statement in contracts.

**Next steps:**
- Confirm audit vendor and scope
- Reserve 1 sprint of engineering capacity for fixes

tasks.name: Prime Care v2 public launch
tasks.description:
**Milestone:** v2 available to all patients on iOS, Android and web.

**Launch criteria:**
- Care-plan tracker out of beta with crash-free rate above 99.5%
- e-Prescription flow live with at least 2 pharmacy partners
- Accessibility fixes from the audit shipped

tasks.name: Post-launch usability study
tasks.description:
**What:** 20 moderated sessions plus in-app survey after launch.

**Why:** Validate that v2 actually reduces the effort to book and follow care plans, and prioritise the Q2 roadmap.

workstreams.name: Tech Integrations
workstreams.goal: Connect Prime Care to labs, pharmacies and hospital records through secure, standards-based (FHIR) interfaces.

tasks.name: FHIR R4 integration gateway
tasks.description:
**What:** A central gateway that translates partner data (HL7v2, CSV, proprietary APIs) into FHIR R4 resources, with audit logging and consent checks.

**Why:** Every downstream integration (labs, pharmacies, hospitals) plugs into this, so we build security and compliance once.

**Blockers:**
- Two high-severity findings from the penetration test are still open

**Next steps:**
- Fix token-expiry and logging findings; re-test on 20 Oct
- Production sign-off by CISO

tasks.name: Lab results integration
tasks.description:
**What:** Receive lab reports from 3 partner lab chains directly into the patient record, with abnormal values flagged for the doctor.

**Why:** Today patients upload PDFs manually; 30% of follow-up consults are delayed waiting for reports.

**Blockers:**
- Largest partner lab has not shared its API sandbox yet
- Depends on the FHIR gateway going live

**Next steps:**
- Escalate sandbox access with the partner's CTO
- Start with the two labs that are ready

tasks.name: e-Prescription & pharmacy API
tasks.description:
**What:** Doctors issue digital prescriptions that are routed to the patient's chosen pharmacy for delivery or pickup.

**Why:** A launch requirement for v2 and a new revenue line through pharmacy partnerships.

**Next steps:**
- Shortlist 2 pharmacy partners
- Confirm regulatory requirements for digital signatures

tasks.name: National health ID linking
tasks.description:
**What:** Let patients link their national health ID so records from other providers can be pulled in with consent.

**Why:** Gives doctors a fuller history and positions Prime Care for public-health programmes.

workstreams.name: Growth & CRM
workstreams.goal: Build a lifecycle engine that turns sign-ups into active, retained patients — target 35% 90-day retention.

tasks.name: CRM platform migration
tasks.description:
**What:** Move patient lifecycle data from spreadsheets and the legacy email tool into a single CRM with event tracking.

**Why:** We can't personalise outreach or measure retention by cohort today.

**Blockers:**
- Data-processing agreement with the CRM vendor under legal review

**Next steps:**
- Complete event schema (sign-up, booking, consult, refill)
- Migrate 180k contacts with consent flags

tasks.name: Onboarding journeys (email / SMS / WhatsApp)
tasks.description:
**What:** Automated first-30-day journeys: welcome, book your first consult, complete your health profile, set up reminders.

**Why:** Patients who book within 7 days of sign-up are 3x more likely to still be active at 90 days.

**Next steps:**
- Draft copy with clinical review
- Set up control group for measurement

tasks.name: Referral programme pilot
tasks.description:
**What:** Give-a-consult, get-a-consult referral rewards for existing patients.

**Why:** Word of mouth is our cheapest channel; pilot to test whether incentives grow it.

tasks.name: Retention dashboard & cohort reporting
tasks.description:
**What:** Weekly cohort retention, activation funnel and channel attribution for leadership.

**Why:** One shared source of truth for growth metrics before the v2 launch.

workstreams.name: Sales
workstreams.goal: Sign 10 employer and clinic partners for Prime Care's B2B care programme by the end of Q1 2027.

tasks.name: Sales deck & pricing model
tasks.description: **Done:** Per-employee-per-month pricing with three tiers, ROI calculator and case-study deck approved by leadership on 8 Oct.

tasks.name: Employer pilot — 3 corporate clients
tasks.description:
**What:** 90-day pilots offering Prime Care as an employee health benefit at three companies (≈4,500 employees in total).

**Why:** Pilot results are our proof point for larger enterprise deals.

**Status:**
- 2 of 3 pilots live; third starts 1 Nov
- Early activation at 22% of eligible employees

**Next steps:**
- Run on-site health camps to lift activation
- Mid-pilot review with HR teams in late November

tasks.name: Clinic partner pipeline (25 qualified leads)
tasks.description:
**What:** Build a pipeline of independent clinics that use Prime Care for teleconsults and follow-ups.

**Why:** Clinics bring existing patient panels and lower acquisition cost.

**Blockers:**
- Only 1 of the 2 planned account executives hired (see Hiring)

**Next steps:**
- Partner with a clinic-management software vendor for warm intros

tasks.name: First 10 partner contracts signed
tasks.description: **Milestone:** 10 signed employer or clinic contracts, at least 3 converted from pilots.

workstreams.name: Social Media
workstreams.goal: Build a trusted health-education presence — 50k engaged followers across Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube.

tasks.name: Brand voice & content pillars
tasks.description:
**What:** Tone of voice, visual templates and four content pillars: everyday health, chronic care, doctor Q&A, patient stories.

**Next steps:**
- Final approval from marketing head on 16 Oct

tasks.name: Doctor-led video series (12 episodes)
tasks.description:
**What:** Short videos where Prime Care doctors answer the most-searched health questions.

**Why:** Doctor-fronted content builds trust and drives search traffic.

**Blockers:**
- Every script needs medical-review sign-off; reviewer capacity is limited

**Next steps:**
- Book studio days and confirm 4 doctors

tasks.name: v2 launch social campaign
tasks.description: **What:** Teaser, launch and sustain phases around the v2 launch, coordinated with the media plan.

tasks.name: Community management playbook
tasks.description: **What:** Response times, escalation rules and a medical-safety protocol for comments and DMs (never give individual medical advice publicly).

workstreams.name: Media Planner
workstreams.goal: Plan and buy paid media that drives qualified sign-ups at a blended acquisition cost within the approved budget.

tasks.name: Annual media plan & budget sign-off
tasks.description:
**What:** Channel mix, monthly budget phasing and KPIs (cost per sign-up, cost per first consult) for the next 12 months.

**Blockers:**
- Finance wants Q1 budget tied to v2 launch date confirmation

**Next steps:**
- Present plan at leadership review on 22 Oct

tasks.name: Media agency selection
tasks.description:
**What:** Pitch process with 3 shortlisted agencies with healthcare advertising experience.

**Next steps:**
- Agency pitches 3–5 Nov; decision by 13 Nov

tasks.name: Performance campaign — wave 1
tasks.description:
**What:** Search, social and app-install campaigns to test creatives and audiences before launch.

**Why:** Find the winning creative and channel mix so launch spend is efficient.

tasks.name: Launch flight (OTT + digital)
tasks.description: **What:** The main v2 launch burst across streaming video and digital channels, measured with geo-holdout tests.

workstreams.name: Hiring
workstreams.goal: Hire the 12 people needed to deliver the v2 roadmap without slowing delivery.

tasks.name: Senior backend engineers (×3)
tasks.description:
**What:** Three senior engineers with healthcare data / integrations experience.

**Status:**
- 1 offer accepted (joins 2 Nov), 2 candidates in final round

**Next steps:**
- Close remaining two by mid-November

tasks.name: Clinical operations lead
tasks.description:
**What:** Senior clinician to own doctor network quality, protocols and medical review.

**Blockers:**
- Preferred candidate has a 90-day notice period

**Next steps:**
- Negotiate notice buy-out or interim consulting arrangement

tasks.name: Product designer
tasks.description: **What:** Senior product designer for the care-plan and chronic-care experience.

tasks.name: Sales account executives (×4)
tasks.description:
**What:** Four AEs for employer and clinic sales.

**Why:** Clinic pipeline target is at risk without more sales capacity.

tasks.name: Team fully staffed
tasks.description: **Milestone:** All 12 planned roles filled and onboarded.
